0.text: Red fills are square; only the clip rounds them. TL 24 · TR 0 · BR 10 · BL 0 unless noted.
Clip layer (nested in a rounded clip)
Nested shape clips intersect: every ancestor's rounded corner still cuts content clipped again by a descendant.
Oversized radii normalise to half the shorter side on every path: TL 9999 draws a 20pt corner.
The glass material normalises its corners like every clip: each glass silhouette (left) matches the content clip of the same radii (right).
